info.title: Cyient DLM Deviation Note API
info.description:
Backend of the Cyient DLM workflow applications. Every endpoint needs sign-in unless it says otherwise.

**Sign-in (Development):** put a login in the `X-Dev-User` header, for example `CYIENTDLM\ims`, using the authentication box on this page. With no header the default user is used. `X-Dev-Groups` adds AD groups.

**Responses** use one envelope: `success`, `data`, `message`, `errors` (each with `code`, `message` and,
for a field, `field`), `meta` (paging: `page`, `pageSize`, `totalCount`, `totalPages`), `traceId` (quote it
when reporting a problem), `timestamp` and `durationMs`. Files (downloads, Excel, PDF) are sent as they are.

**Errors:** 400/422 validation (`errors[].field` names the field), 401 not signed in, 403 not allowed or not
set up (`AUTH_NOT_REGISTERED`), 404 not found, 409 conflict, such as `PLATFORM_VERSION_CONFLICT` when someone
else saved first, 429 too many calls.

**Changes:** send back the `version` from the last read; a stale one gets 409. New drafts take an
`Idempotency-Key` header, so a repeated click returns the same draft. Dates are `yyyy-MM-dd` in India
time; times are UTC. Enums travel as names, such as `ImsReview`.

post.description:
Update: saves the reviewer's comment on their step without moving the deviation on.

Only the person the request is waiting for may act: the reporting manager, then each box's reviewer in the category's order. Nobody acts on their own deviation (`403 AUTH_OWN_REQUEST`); others get `403 AUTH_NOT_ASSIGNED_REVIEWER`. A comment is required. Send the `version` from the last read.

ApiResponseOfRoleDetails.description: The envelope every JSON response uses (design 6.2). File downloads are the only exception.

ApiResponseOfStoredFile.description: The envelope every JSON response uses (design 6.2). File downloads are the only exception.

ApiResponseOfUserDetails.description: The envelope every JSON response uses (design 6.2). File downloads are the only exception.

ApiResponseOfVersionInfo.description: The envelope every JSON response uses (design 6.2). File downloads are the only exception.

comment.description: Shown on the History tab. Required (RULE-04).

furtherApprovalRequired.description: Head of department only, and then required: Yes adds one final approver, No closes the deviation (BR-DN-06).

finalApproverUserId.description: The final approver when further approval is required: an `id` from the people picker.

version.description: The `version` from the last read; a stale one gets `409 PLATFORM_VERSION_CONFLICT`.

ApproveInput.description: Approve; the head of department also answers "further approval required".

BoxAssignment.description: A person entered in one reviewer or approver box.

userId.description: The new person: an `id` from the people picker. Required.

reason.description: Why, shown on the request's History tab. Required.

version.description: The `version` from the last read; a stale one gets `409 PLATFORM_VERSION_CONFLICT`.

ChangeReviewerInput.description: Puts another person in a step that is not done yet.

DnSummaryMonth.description: Requests raised in one month (by request date) and how many of them are approved, rejected or still open.

initiatorDepartmentId.description: The `id` of a Department item (`GET /api/v1/masters/Department`). Required.

workOrderNo.description: W.O No. Required, at most 50 characters.

lineCellEquipmentNo.description: Line No. / Cell No / Equip No. Required, at most 100 characters.

customerId.description: The `id` of a Customer item (`GET /api/v1/masters/Customer`). Required.

productFgNumber.description: Product FG (part) number. Required, at most 100 characters.

unitId.description: The `id` of a Unit item (`GET /api/v1/masters/Unit`). Required.

changeCategoryId.description: The `id` of a ChangeCategory item (`GET /api/v1/masters/ChangeCategory`). Required; it decides the reviewer and approver boxes.

prescribedProcess.description: Prescribed / defined process. Required, at most 4000 characters.

processChangeRequired.description: Process change required. Required, at most 4000 characters.

reasonForChange.description: Reason for change. Required, at most 4000 characters.

preventiveAction.description: Action taken to prevent re-occurrence. Required, at most 4000 characters.

reviewers.description: The person in each box of the category. A draft may leave boxes empty; every mandatory box must be filled to submit (RULE-02). The reporting manager is not sent: it comes from the org structure (RULE-01).

informedUserIds.description: People to be informed: `id`s from the people picker. Optional.

version.description: Required when editing: the version returned by the last read.

DraftDetails.description: The Deviation Request and Reviewers tabs, as sent when creating or editing a draft.

EmailDetails.description: An email with what caused it: who acted, and the workflow action (design 9.4).

HistoryEntry.description: One line of a request's full history. Workflow lines have Stage, Action and Comment; data lines have Item (Request, Reviewer, Person to be informed or Document), Action (Insert, Update, Delete, Download, Pdf) and, for updates, Field with its old and new value.

userId.description: The user to give the role to: an `id` from the users list or the people picker.

adGroup.description: An Active Directory group as DOMAIN\Group; its members get the role.

HolderInput.description: Either a user or an AD group (DOMAIN\Group), not both.

userIds.description: `id`s from the people picker; an empty list removes everyone.

reason.description: Why, shown on the request's History tab. Required.

version.description: The `version` from the last read; a stale one gets `409 PLATFORM_VERSION_CONFLICT`.

InformedPeopleInput.description: The people to be informed, replacing the current list.

timeZone.description: The zone DailyAt is in: the job's own, or the business time zone.

nextRun.description: When the Notification Service runs it next; null when the job is switched off.

LogEntry.description: One History entry: who did what at which step, when, with the comment. Stage is the step's name (Reporting Manager, a category box, Initiator); ActionName is how users know the action (Require more details, Close DN).

code.description: A short code, for example HYD. Required, at most 50 characters.

name.description: The name shown in drop-downs. Required, at most 200 characters.

isActive.description: False stops the item being offered; items are never deleted.

version.description: Needed when changing an item; ignored when creating one.

type.description: The list's key, used in the URLs: Location, Department or ReasonCategory.

name.description: The list's display name, for screens only.

pendingCount.description: Tasks waiting for the user in this application (the Pending Actions badge); null where the application has none.

NumberingCheckResult.description:
One counter compared with the numbers its application has actually given out. Numbers are gap-free by design
(design 5.7), so any missing or repeated number, or a counter below a used number, needs looking at.

PersonResult.description: One result of the people picker.

statusName.description: The status as users know it, for example "Pending" or "Closed by admin".

pendingRole.description: The step it waits at, for example Reporting Manager, a category box, or Initiator.

documentCount.description: Uploaded reference documents and reviewer attachments (current versions).

RequestListItem.description: One row of My Requests and All Requests, with Type of Change, Pending With, Pending Role and Status (Scr 2, 3).

ReviewerBox.description: A reviewer or approver box of a change category, for the Reviewers tab.

ReviewerBoxDetails.description: A reviewer box with its state and version, for IT's maintenance of the category sequences.

changeCategoryId.description: The `id` of a ChangeCategory item. Required.

sequence.description: Position in the category's order, from 1. Required; unique within the category.

name.description: The box's label, shown as the Pending Role. Required, at most 50 characters.

isHeadOfDepartment.description: The head of department box: the last step, which answers "further approval required". One per category.

isMandatory.description: Must be filled before submission. Defaults to true.

isActive.description: Set to false to stop offering the box; boxes are never deleted, as requests point at them.

version.description: Required when changing: the version from the list.

ReviewerBoxInput.description: A reviewer or approver box of a change category, as sent when adding or changing it.

ReviewerDetails.description: One step of the request's sequence with its outcome; the Reviewers tab.

RoleHolder.description: One holder of a role: a user, or an AD group whose members hold it.

isActive.description: False switches the role off: its holders lose its permissions.

permissions.description: The full list of permission codes (`GET /api/v1/admin/permissions`); it replaces the current list.

version.description: Needed when changing a role; ignored when creating one.

RoleInput.description: A role's name, description, state and the full list of its permission codes.

startingSerialNo.description: Starting serial number. Required, at most 50 characters.

endingSerialNo.description: Ending serial number. Required, at most 50 characters.

version.description: The `version` from the last read; a stale one gets `409 PLATFORM_VERSION_CONFLICT`.

SerialsInput.description: The affected serial range, recorded by the production supervisor after approval.

StoredFile.description: One version of an uploaded document. Versions of the same document share a Guid StoredFile.FileKey.

UserRoleItem.description: A role the user holds directly; int UserRoleItem.HolderId is used to remove it.

isActive.description: False switches the user off, true switches them on again.

version.description: The `version` from the last read; a stale one gets `409 PLATFORM_VERSION_CONFLICT`.

commit.description: The git commit the build came from, so support can tell exactly which build is running.

comment.description: Shown on the History tab. Required for every reviewer action (RULE-04) and for a resubmission.

version.description: The `version` from the last read; a stale one gets `409 PLATFORM_VERSION_CONFLICT`.

WorkflowActionInput.description: A workflow action: the comment and the version from the last read.

DevUser.description: Development sign-in: the login to act as, for example `CYIENTDLM\ims`. Left empty, calls are made as the default user.
DevUser.name: X-Dev-User

tags.name: Me
tags.description: The signed-in user, with the roles and permission codes the front end uses to show or hide actions.

tags.name: Requests: drafts
tags.description: Deviation Requests: drafts, with the reviewer and approver boxes of their change category (design 6.7).

tags.name: Requests: workflow
tags.description: The Deviation Note workflow (design 6.7): submit, the reviewer actions, the serial range, Pending Requests and the History tab. Reviewer actions need only sign-in here; who may act at each step is checked by the workflow itself.

tags.name: Requests: documents
tags.description: Reference documents and reviewer attachments (design 6.7): upload a file or a new version, list them, download one.

tags.name: Requests: lists and reports
tags.description: My Requests and All Requests, the Excel export, the PDF of a closed deviation and the DN summary (design 6.7). Files are the one response not wrapped in the envelope; an error before the file starts still is.

tags.name: Master lists
tags.description: Master lists. Anyone signed in reads the active items (for drop-downs); administrators with master.manage see inactive ones too, add items and change them.

tags.name: People picker
tags.description: The people picker, for choosing approvers (design 6.7). Any signed-in user; only active people are found.

tags.name: System
tags.description: Which build of the application this server runs. Any signed-in user.

tags.name: Admin: Deviation Note
tags.description: Deviation Note administration, today's admin rights (BRD-03 BR-DN-11): Close DN, and adding or removing people on a deviation that is not yet approved (request.admin). Each action needs a comment and is shown on the History tab.

tags.name: Admin: audit, emails and logs
tags.description: The audit trail (audit.view), the email log with retry and resend (email.manage), and the technical log (log.view). Lists are newest first and paged.

tags.name: Admin: jobs
tags.description: The daily jobs (job.run): when each runs next in the Notification Service, and "run now". A job run now runs in this API and the call returns when it has finished.

tags.name: Admin: numbering
tags.description: Request-number counters and the numbering check (sequence.manage). Read-only: counters are never set by hand.

tags.name: Admin: roles
tags.description: Roles and their permissions (role.manage), and who holds them (user.manage). Holders are users or AD groups. A change that would leave nobody able to manage roles and users is refused.

tags.name: Admin: users
tags.description: People synced from Active Directory: search them, see their roles, switch them off or on in this application.
